name: Goa
description: India's beach state: palm-lined coast, Portuguese-era churches, seafood shacks and lively nights.

name: Manali
description: Himalayan resort town in the Kullu valley, base for treks, snow trips and the road to Ladakh.

name: Rishikesh
description: Yoga capital on the Ganga with river rafting, ashrams, cafes and evening aarti.

name: Jaipur
description: The Pink City: hilltop forts, royal palaces, busy bazaars and Rajasthani food.

name: Udaipur
description: City of lakes and white palaces, known for sunset boat rides and old-city lanes.

name: Varanasi
description: One of the world's oldest living cities, centred on the ghats and rituals of the Ganga.

name: Leh
description: High-altitude capital of Ladakh with monasteries, mountain passes and stark desert landscapes.

name: Munnar
description: Kerala hill station blanketed in tea estates, misty viewpoints and easy walking trails.

name: Alleppey
description: Backwater hub where houseboats drift through canals, paddy fields and coconut groves.

name: Hampi
description: Ruins of the Vijayanagara capital scattered among giant boulders beside the Tungabhadra river.

name: Pondicherry
description: Former French colony with pastel streets, a seaside promenade, cafes and Auroville nearby.

name: Darjeeling
description: Colonial hill town famous for tea gardens, the toy train and Kanchenjunga sunrise views.

name: Gangtok
description: Sikkim's tidy capital, gateway to high lakes, monasteries and north Sikkim valleys.

name: Shillong
description: Meghalaya's hill capital with waterfalls, pine hills, live music and a relaxed cafe scene.

name: Agra
description: Home of the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort and Mughal-era architecture along the Yamuna.

name: Mysore
description: City of palaces and sandalwood, best known for its grand Dasara festival.

name: Coorg
description: Coffee country in the Western Ghats with plantations, waterfalls and homestays.

name: Andaman Islands
description: Island chain with clear water, coral reefs, white-sand beaches and diving.

name: Kochi
description: Historic port mixing Chinese fishing nets, colonial Fort Kochi, spice markets and art.

name: Jaisalmer
description: The Golden City: a living sandstone fort, havelis and camel safaris into the Thar desert.

name: Ladakh Nubra
description: Cold desert valley beyond Khardung La with sand dunes, monasteries and Bactrian camels.

name: Kasol
description: Riverside village in the Parvati valley, popular with backpackers and as a trek base.

name: Spiti Valley
description: Remote high-altitude valley of ancient monasteries, tiny villages and dramatic roads.

name: Ooty
description: Classic Nilgiri hill station with botanical gardens, a lake and the mountain railway.

name: Rann of Kutch
description: Vast white salt desert that hosts the Rann Utsav festival under full-moon skies.

name: Amritsar
description: Home of the Golden Temple, the Wagah border ceremony and hearty Punjabi food.

name: Khajuraho
description: Temple town famed for intricately carved medieval Hindu and Jain temples.

name: Tawang
description: Remote Arunachal town with one of India's largest monasteries and high mountain lakes.

name: Gokarna
description: Laid-back temple town with quiet beaches linked by coastal walking trails.

name: Bir Billing
description: India's paragliding capital, with Tibetan settlements and tea gardens.

name: Wayanad
description: Green Kerala district of forests, wildlife, caves and spice plantations.

name: Mahabaleshwar
description: Sahyadri hill station known for viewpoints, strawberries and monsoon greenery.

name: Kaziranga
description: National park on the Brahmaputra floodplains, home to the one-horned rhino.

name: Pushkar
description: Holy lakeside town with ghats, temples and the famous annual camel fair.

name: Kodaikanal
description: Tamil Nadu hill station around a star-shaped lake, with forests and cliffs.

name: Dharamshala
description: Hill town and seat of the Tibetan government-in-exile, with McLeod Ganj above it.

name: Shimla
description: Former British summer capital with a ridge-top mall road, colonial buildings and pine forests.

name: Mussoorie
description: The 'Queen of the Hills', a ridge town with Doon valley views and Himalayan vistas.

name: Nainital
description: Lake town in the Kumaon hills known for boating, viewpoints and cool summers.

name: Auli
description: Ski slopes and meadows with views of Nanda Devi, reached by one of Asia's longest ropeways.

name: Jim Corbett
description: India's oldest national park, known for tiger safaris, river views and birdlife.

name: Haridwar
description: Holy city where the Ganga leaves the hills, famous for the Har Ki Pauri evening aarti.

name: Chopta
description: Meadow hamlet and base for the Tungnath and Chandrashila treks.

name: Valley of Flowers
description: UNESCO-listed alpine valley carpeted with wildflowers in the monsoon months.

name: Lansdowne
description: Quiet cantonment hill town with oak and pine forests, far from the crowds.

name: Dalhousie
description: Colonial-era hill station spread over five hills, close to the Khajjiar meadow.

name: Kasauli
description: Small, quiet hill town with pine walks and old churches near Chandigarh.

name: Tirthan Valley
description: Riverside valley at the edge of the Great Himalayan National Park, known for trout and homestays.

name: Srinagar
description: Kashmir's summer capital of Dal Lake houseboats, shikaras and Mughal gardens.

name: Gulmarg
description: Meadow resort known for skiing in winter and the high Gulmarg gondola.

name: Pahalgam
description: Lidder valley town of pine forests and meadows, starting point for the Amarnath route.

name: Delhi
description: India's capital, layering Mughal monuments, old bazaars, street food and museums.

name: Jodhpur
description: The Blue City below the massive Mehrangarh Fort, with lively old-town markets.

name: Mount Abu
description: Rajasthan's only hill station, home to the marble Dilwara temples and Nakki Lake.

name: Ranthambore
description: Tiger reserve around a ruined hilltop fort, one of the best places to spot tigers.

name: Chittorgarh
description: Home to one of India's largest forts, steeped in Rajput history.

name: Mumbai
description: India's busiest city, with seafront promenades, colonial landmarks and famous street food.

name: Lonavala
description: Ghat hill station between Mumbai and Pune, at its greenest in the monsoon.

name: Alibaug
description: Coastal weekend spot near Mumbai with beaches and sea forts.

name: Aurangabad
description: Base for the rock-cut Ajanta and Ellora caves, both UNESCO World Heritage Sites.

name: Dwarka
description: Ancient coastal pilgrimage town centred on the Dwarkadhish temple.

name: Gir National Park
description: The last wild home of the Asiatic lion, explored on jeep safaris.

name: Diu
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Small former Portuguese island with a seaside fort, churches and quiet beaches.

name: Chikmagalur
description: Coffee-growing hills with Karnataka's highest peak, Mullayanagiri, and estate stays.

name: Badami
description: Red sandstone cave temples beside a lake, close to Aihole and Pattadakal.

name: Bengaluru
description: Garden city and tech hub known for its cafes, breweries, parks and pleasant weather.

name: Varkala
description: Clifftop beach town with cafes, yoga and sunset views over the Arabian Sea.

name: Kovalam
description: Crescent beaches with a lighthouse and Ayurvedic stays near Thiruvananthapuram.

name: Thekkady
description: Gateway to Periyar Tiger Reserve, with spice gardens, boat rides and jungle walks.

name: Vagamon
description: Rolling meadows, pine forests and paragliding in the quieter Kerala hills.

name: Kanyakumari
description: India's southern tip, where three seas meet, famed for sunrise and sunset.

name: Madurai
description: Temple city built around the towering Meenakshi Amman temple.

name: Rameswaram
description: Island pilgrimage town reached by the Pamban bridge, near Dhanushkodi's ghost town.

name: Mahabalipuram
description: Seaside town of Pallava-era rock carvings and the UNESCO-listed Shore Temple.

name: Chennai
description: Coastal capital of Tamil culture, temples, filter coffee and the long Marina beach.

name: Yercaud
description: Budget-friendly hill station in the Shevaroy hills with coffee estates and a lake.

name: Araku Valley
description: Eastern Ghats valley of coffee plantations, tribal culture and the Borra caves.

name: Visakhapatnam
description: Port city with long beaches, hilltop viewpoints and a submarine museum.

name: Hyderabad
description: City of the Charminar, Golconda Fort, pearls and the famous Hyderabadi biryani.

name: Puri
description: Coastal pilgrimage town of the Jagannath temple, near the Konark Sun Temple.

name: Kolkata
description: The cultural capital: colonial architecture, trams, sweets and Durga Puja.

name: Sundarbans
description: The world's largest mangrove delta, home of the Royal Bengal tiger, explored by boat.

name: Bodh Gaya
description: Where the Buddha attained enlightenment, centred on the Mahabodhi temple.

name: Pelling
description: West Sikkim village with close Kanchenjunga views and the Pemayangtse monastery.

name: Cherrapunji
description: One of the wettest places on earth, with living root bridges and tall waterfalls.

name: Dawki
description: Border town on the Umngot river, known for boat rides on strikingly clear water.

name: Ziro
description: Pine-ringed valley of Apatani villages and rice fields, home to a music festival.

name: Majuli
description: Large river island in the Brahmaputra, known for Vaishnavite monasteries and mask-making.

name: Orchha
description: Riverside town of medieval palaces, temples and cenotaphs on the Betwa.

name: Pachmarhi
description: Madhya Pradesh's only hill station, with waterfalls, caves and Satpura forests.

name: Ujjain
description: Ancient temple city on the Shipra, home of the Mahakaleshwar jyotirlinga.

name: Bandhavgarh
description: Tiger reserve with one of the highest tiger densities in India and an old hill fort.

name: Lakshadweep
description: Coral atolls with lagoons and reefs; visiting needs an entry permit.
